checks.description: A weapon's dice mean is between 1d6 and 2d10.
No armor piece passes the highest worn-set DR of its category.
The best set per category lands in its worn-set band. Warning until the armor DR pass.
A monster's strongest attack or damage ability is within its tier's expected damage.
A monster takes the hits of its role's band (standard 4 to 6, boss 8 to 12, minion 1 to 2) of its tier's damage.
A stock drink's static toxicity is within the tolerance of formulas/toxicity.json.
The toxicity formula gives an instant total more toxicity than the same total over time.
At magic_skill, a Potion of Mana spent on the best spell for a pool restores more per toxicity than any stock drink for that pool.
A stock scroll costs at least scroll_gp_per_mana gold per mana of its spell.
